title: Fairy of Time and Holly
description: A pale-skinned fairy with long flowing white hair and large purple-and-white butterfly wings stands centered on a stone path. She wears a white and purple robe, holds a glowing pink orb containing red holly berries in her right hand, and carries a large melting clock with dripping gold in her left arm.
prompt: A beautiful pale fairy with long flowing white hair and large purple and white butterfly wings stands on a stone path surrounded by holly and sunflowers. She holds a glowing pink orb with red holly berries, while carrying a large melting clock with golden drips. A purple crescent moon and classical columns are behind her, with white butterflies flying in a dramatic sky that transitions from sunset orange to dark purple and black clouds.
